spans.s:
(इ) श्लकि r. 1st cl. (श्लंकते)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं)
1 Small, fine, minute.
2 Gentle, mild, amiable.
3 Honest, sincere.
4 Plain, even, smooth.
E.
श्लिष to embrace, क्स्न aff., the short vowel substituted for the penultimate.

(इ) श्लगि r. 1st cl. (श्लंङ्गति)
To go, to move.

r. 10th cl. (श्लथयमि)
To be weak, to be relaxed, loose, flaccid.
r. 1st cl. (श्लथयति)
To hurt or kill.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Loose, flaccid, relaxed.
2 Dishevelled (hair).
3 Untied, unfastened.
E.
श्लथ to be relaxed, aff. अच्.

(ऋ) श्लाघृ r. 1st cl. (श्लाघते)
1 To praise, to eulogise.
2 To flatter, to coax, to wheedle.
3 To boast.

f. (-घा)
1 Praise, panegyric, flattery, eulogium.
2 Service, obedience.
3 Wish, desire.
E.
श्लाघ to praise, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, commended.
E.
श्लाघ to praise, क्त aff.

mfn. (-घ्यः-घ्या-घ्यं)
Venerable, respectable, praise-worthy, entitled to praise or veneration.
E.
श्लाघा praise, यत् aff.
